label: Listening Room (ITU-R BS.1116-1), University of Salford
note: mid-frequency RT 0.27 s, background noise 5.7 dBA (SOFA RoomDescription); dimensions and volume from the SOFA RoomCornerA/B, RoomType shoebox (ash_ir/r03, the same room, gives 5.80 x 6.60 x 2.70 m); 12 Genelec 8030A loudspeakers on a 2.1 m ring at ear height (1.06 m), source e0-e11 at azimuth 0, 30, 45, 90, 110, 135, 180, 225, 250, 270, 315, 330 degrees; 15 listener positions on a 0.5 m grid (x -1 to 1 m, y -1 to 0 m from the ring centre); receiver = listener position and torso orientation in degrees (B&K Type 4100 HATS), e.g. x0y-0pt5_m120; only the 180 measured orientations (2 degree steps) are indexed; the listener x, y come from the file name, since 4 files state ListenerPosition y = +0.5
